title: Cellohood: multi-granular discovery of cellular neighborhoods with a permutation-invariant set transformer auto-encoder
description: Cellohood is a Python package implementing a permutation-invariant set transformer auto-encoder for multi-granular discovery of cellular neighborhoods from spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics data.
